description: A six-operator frequency modulation voice in the Yamaha DX7 line, playing patches read from DX7 cartridge files, polyphonic to sixteen voices

params.text: Picks the patch within the current bank, 0 to 31
Picks which loaded bank the patch comes from
Steps back one patch on each press
Steps on one patch on each press
Tilts the whole timbre darker or brighter by scaling how hard the modulating operators drive the ones they feed, -100 to 100 per cent
Shifts the patch's own feedback amount, -7 to 7, which adds or takes away the buzz the feedback operator contributes

inputs.text: Sets the pitch as a volt per octave; the number of channels here is what sets the module's polyphony
A rise starts a note and a fall releases it, one channel per voice; short triggers work as well as held gates
Sets how hard each note is struck, 0-10V, sampled as the note starts and applied through the patch's own velocity sensitivity
Picks the patch, 0-10V across the thirty-two slots, added to the voice knob
Picks the bank, one volt per bank, added to the bank knob
Transposes the voice a volt per octave, added to the tune knob
Tilts the timbre, ±5V across the whole brightness range
Shifts the feedback amount, ±5V across the whole feedback range

outputs.text: The voice with its own DX7 envelope applied, ready to be heard without an external amplifier
The raw tone with no envelope applied, sounding for as long as a voice is held, for shaping with an envelope of your own
Follows the loudness of the voice, 0-10V per channel, for ducking or for driving other modulation from how loud a note is

notes: the module ships with four DX7 patches already loaded, so it makes sound as soon as a gate arrives; further banks are loaded from the menu
the display has two tabs: one draws the six operators in the patch's routing, where clicking an operator silences it, and the other draws the envelope with a moving trace over it
placing an OP MORPH immediately to the right turns the fixed routing into a field that can be travelled across
menu: Algorithm morph — a label over the morph items below it
Morph toward — a submenu of the thirty-two DX7 algorithms, picking the routing the patch is blended toward
Banks — a label over the bank items below it
Load bank (.syx)… — reads a thirty-two voice DX7 cartridge file, which is then kept with the patch
Remove current bank — drops the selected bank; it appears only once more than one bank is loaded
